source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of Class P (PDF 74-75).

blocks.text: Class P un masail ki category hai jo computer efficiently (kam waqt mein) hal kar sakta hai. Asaan alfaaz mein: yeh woh masail hain jin ka hal computer jaldi dhoond leta hai, chahe masle ka size barhta jaye.
Misal: ek saada masla lein: numbers ki list ko sort karna (tarteeb dena).
Farz karein aap ke paas yeh list hai:
Maqsad in numbers ko ascending order (chhote se bare ki tarteeb) mein lagana hai:

items: Easy to Solve (hal karna aasan): computer sorting ka masla efficiently hal kar sakta hai. List bari hone par sort karne ka waqt qabil-e-intezam raftar se barhta hai.
Polynomial Time: matlab zaroori waqt aisi raftar se barhta hai jis ka pehle se andaza lagaya ja sake aur jo maqool ho. Kitab ki misal: list ka size dugna karne se waqt taqreeban dugna ho jata hai.

Deterministic Algorithm (pakke qadmon wala algorithm): sorting saaf qadmon ka set (recipe) istemal karti hai. Maslan algorithm numbers ka muwazna kar ke unhein swap karta hai (jagah badalta hai). In qadmon par theek theek chalne se hamesha durust nateeja milta hai.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke list dugni karne se waqt taqreeban dugna hota hai. Yeh baat linear O(n) kaam par poori sahi hai. O(n log n) wali sorting (Merge Sort) mein waqt dugne se thora zyada, aur neeche wale compare-and-swap tareeqe (Bubble Sort, O(n²)) mein taqreeban chaar guna ho jata hai (topic 3.5.1 bhi yahi kehta hai). Phir bhi yeh sab polynomial hain, is liye sorting Class P mein hi hai.
List [4, 1, 3, 2, 5] ko sort karne ke liye computer yeh qadam utha sakta hai:

items: Pehle number ka doosre number se muwazna karein. Zaroorat ho to dono ki jagah badal dein (swap).
Agle jore (pair) par jayein aur yahi amal dohrayein.
Yeh tab tak jari rakhein jab tak poori list sort na ho jaye.

blocks.text: List ka size barhne par sort karne ka waqt qabil-e-intezam raftar se barhta hai. Maslan 5 numbers se 10 numbers par jane se waqt barhega, magar maqool had ke andar rahega.

blocks.prompt: Kaunsi complexity class un masail ki hai jo deterministic algorithm se efficiently hal hote hain (MCQ 2)?

items: Class P: saaf deterministic qadmon se polynomial time mein (jaldi) hal; sorting Class P mein hai.
